info.title: Continuum AI Task internal API — DATN-97 seven-field slice
info.description: PROPOSED, NOT APPROVED contract for the DATN-97 (D-05) seven-field Task slice: list by Project and detail only. Scope follows the Leader's partial approval of the Document D05-DR1 decision request (https://github.com/DATN-SPRING2027/Document/pull/44#issuecomment-6248155568), recorded in Document doc 25 (https://github.com/DATN-SPRING2027/Document/pull/46): DR-1/2/5/6/7(a)(b) approved and DR-4 (whole-Project read) approved only conditionally, all under a delegation that is still an open note. Create is deliberately omitted until DR-7(c)(d) is recorded; no mutation, status, assignment, filter, sort, history or Idempotency-Key exists in this slice. These are internal Task-service routes, disabled by default, behind the deny-by-default authorization boundary; DR-3 (trust profile) and DR-8 (scope evidence) are DEFER, so no route may be activated from this contract. A task exposes exactly id, projectId, title, createdBy, createdAt, updatedAt and version. version is informational and is not a CAS/ETag. See x-pending-decisions for choices the drafter made that need explicit approval.

x-approval-status: PROPOSED — not approved; handlers must not be written before an authority records approval of this OpenAPI
x-decision-refs: DR-1 A, DR-2 A, DR-5, DR-6 A, DR-7(a)(b) approved; DR-4 approved conditionally pending confirmation of the Product/Security delegation; DR-3, DR-7(c)(d), DR-8 DEFER
x-pending-decisions: DR4-1: the permission for every ACTIVE Organization Member with an ACTIVE ProjectMembership to list and read every Task of the Project is DR-4, approved only conditionally in Document doc 25 until the Product/Security delegation is confirmed. The read scope of both routes is not final until then and must not be used as a policy ALLOW rule or handler behavior before that confirmation.

PATH-1: path shape /internal/tasks/projects/{projectId}/tasks[/{taskId}] is the drafter's choice (keeps the approved /internal/tasks prefix and gives the existing TaskAuthorizationHttpGuard a project path parameter and a detail resource parameter); needs Architecture confirmation.
LIMIT-1: default limit 20 is the drafter's choice; DR-6 only fixes the 1-100 range.

CURSOR-1: nextAfterId is the id of the last item when the page is full (items.length equals limit) and null otherwise, so a client may receive one empty final page; this avoids a repository change. Needs confirmation.

ERR-1: mapping of authorization denial reasons to HTTP (401, 404, 503), 422 for a malformed limit or afterId, and the error codes are the drafter's proposal built on DR-5, which covers only 404 for non-member or cross-scope access; PERMISSION_DENIED mapped to 404 and a malformed path id mapped to 404 are this proposal only. A malformed projectId or taskId path value reaches authorization first and is reported as 404, so the detail route has no 422. PERMISSION_DENIED mapped to 404 and the precedence of authorization over input validation need Security/Architecture confirmation. Implementation precondition: the existing TaskAuthorizationHttpGuard returns a boolean and drops the denial reason (Nest would answer a generic 403), so the handler pull request must add a reason-aware mapping to 401, 404 and 503.
CACHE-1: Cache-Control no-store on 200 responses follows the existing membership read contract; needs confirmation.

AUTH-1: the bearer credential is an opaque verifier input; issuer, audience, token format and service identity (mTLS) are DR-3 and are not specified here. The scope-evidence source and revocation handling are DR-8 and are not specified here.

tags.name: Task slice
tags.description: Internal Task-service routes for the DATN-97 seven-field slice. Disabled by default.

get.summary: List Tasks of one Project (cursor pagination)
get.description: Conditional on DR-4 (approved only conditionally, see x-pending-decisions DR4-1): an ACTIVE Organization Membership and an ACTIVE ProjectMembership may list every Task of the Project (the approver stated reading the whole Project is intentional); both are validated server-side. DR-6: cursor pagination, limit 1-100, ordered by _id ascending; there is no page, total, filter or sort parameter. Authorization runs before input validation, and only limit and afterId are validated afterwards (422). Non-member and cross-scope callers receive 404 (DR-5); a malformed projectId also receives 404 as the drafter's proposal ERR-1.

200.description: One page of Tasks in _id ascending order.

get.summary: Get one Task of a Project
get.description: Conditional on DR-4 and covered by DR-5 for non-member and cross-scope access, as for the list route. The lookup is always bound to both projectId and taskId, so a Task of another Project is indistinguishable from a missing Task and returns 404. A malformed projectId or taskId is also reported as 404 because authorization runs first and there are no other inputs to validate, so this route has no 422.

taskDelegationBearer.description: Opaque delegated-context credential from the trusted caller, treated as a verifier input. Its profile and the service identity are DR-3 (DEFER) and are not defined by this contract. Browser-supplied actor or Project headers are never identity proof.

ProjectId.name: projectId
ProjectId.description: Project id. It must match the Project bound in the verified context; a mismatch or a malformed value is reported as 404.

TaskId.name: taskId
TaskId.description: Task id. A malformed value is reported as 404.

Limit.name: limit
Limit.description: Page size, 1-100 (DR-6). The default is a drafter's choice, see x-pending-decisions LIMIT-1.

AfterId.name: afterId
AfterId.description: Return Tasks with _id greater than this id. Use the nextAfterId of the previous page.

Unauthenticated.description: The credential is missing or cannot be verified (authorization denial UNVERIFIED_CONTEXT). Profile details are DR-3.

NotFound.description: The Task or Project does not exist or is not visible to the caller. Non-member and cross-scope access (including a Project or resource mismatch) return this response without revealing existence (DR-5). A denied permission and a malformed path id also return it, but that is the drafter's proposal ERR-1, not an approved decision.

ValidationFailed.description: A query value of the list route is malformed: limit is not an integer from 1 to 100, or afterId is not a 24-character hexadecimal id. Returned only after authorization succeeds. A malformed projectId or taskId path value is not reported here: it reaches authorization first and is returned as 404, indistinguishable from a missing resource.

messages: limit must not be greater than 100

AuthorizationUnavailable.description: Project scope evidence or the permission policy is unavailable (PROJECT_SCOPE_UNAVAILABLE, PERMISSION_POLICY_UNAVAILABLE). The request fails closed; internal topology and credentials are omitted. The evidence source is DR-8.

InternalError.description: The operation failed unexpectedly. The response contains no database details, stack trace, topology or credentials.

Task.description: The approved D-03 seven-field Task. No status, priority, assignee, team, dueDate, tags or description exists in this slice.

title.description: The original string as stored. No business length cap and no normalization (doc 22 P2, DR-7(b)); existing BSON size limits apply.

updatedAt.description: ISO-8601 UTC. Equal to createdAt in this slice.

version.description: Informational creation ordinal. It is not a CAS/ETag and there is no expectedVersion in this slice (DR-1).

nextAfterId.description: Id of the last item when the page is full, otherwise null. See x-pending-decisions CURSOR-1.

ErrorResponse.description: The existing backend error shape produced by StructuredExceptionFilter (DR-5).

details.description: Machine-readable context. Use an empty object when no additional context is safe to expose.
